# Research instructions

- Search through the stated cutoff date and prefer papers, official technical reports, repositories, standards, and specifications.
- Separate pretraining, fine-tuning, RL, inference, and simulation results.
- Record parameters, active parameters, tokens, hardware, topology, network, trust model, baseline, replication, and limitations when available.
- Seek counterevidence and classify vendor-reported results clearly.
- Update `docs/research/evidence-matrix.md`, `docs/research/bibliography.md`, and affected requirements in one change.
